name: Virology Capabilities Test v2 — Text 101
protocol: VCT v2 fixed text-only 101-question subset, zero-shot exact answer-set match, ten runs; full multimodal and partial-credit variants excluded.

explanation.en: A question passes only when the selected answer set exactly matches the complete reference set.
explanation.zh: 只有所选答案集合与完整参考集合完全一致时才得分。

summary.en: VCT-Text evaluates difficult virology laboratory and troubleshooting knowledge.
summary.zh: VCT-Text 评估高难度病毒学实验和故障排查知识。

task_format.en: Select every correct statement from four to ten candidates for 101 text-only questions.
task_format.zh: 在 101 道纯文本题中，从 4–10 个候选陈述里选出全部正确项。
